Date: 2026-06-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot packaging + rate ask (Zenith Biomed)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile on the private deployment. We're moving forward with a 6-month clinical pilot (internal stakeholders: Amit, Dr. Ellison), but the current rate card puts the program outside our pilot budget.

High-level ask:
- 45% off hosted unit rates for the first 6 months (pilot period)
- Waive onboarding surcharge and provide 3 months of monitoring credits
- Commitment: 6 months, estimated 20M tokens / month, option to convert to Dedicated at negotiated uplift if we hit thresholds

I've attached our proposed commercial terms and a simple usage projection (ZEN_Rate_Sheet_v3.pdf, MAP_proposal.xlsx). Can Redwood provide an approval pathway for an exception like this? We need to present internally next week.

Appreciate a quick run-through of what flexibility exists and any exec signoff required.

Best,
Janet Wu
Head of Platform Partnerships
Zenith Biomed

Attachments: ZEN_Rate_Sheet_v3.pdf, MAP_proposal.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Cc: Janet Wu <janet@zenithbiomed.com>, Amit Rao <amit@zenithbiomed.com>
Date: 2026-06-09T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot packaging + rate ask (Zenith Biomed) — internal analysis

Sofia / Jordan — I ran a quick margin / SLO risk sensitivity based on their MAP_proposal.xlsx. Key takeaways:

- At 20M tokens/month, a 45% flat discount on hosted rates would push the unit contribution margin negative for the first 3 months unless we narrow scope or enforce a consumption cap.
- If we structure a staged discount (35% month 1–3, 25% month 4–6) + 2 months prepayment, contribution recovers to low double-digits by month 4.
- Waiving onboarding surcharge is reasonable if they prepay or provide a short-term commitment anchor (po or signed statement of intent).

Recommended commercial guardrails:
1) Staged discount: 35% / 25% with retro true-up if they convert to Dedicated (credit applied to first quarter of Dedicated).
2) Soft cap: 30M tokens/month hard cap; overage billed at base list less 10%.
3) Prepayment: 2 months committed up front (applied as credits).
4) 90-day monitoring credits (not 3 months) to limit long tail costs.

I've attached a 1-page sensitivity (pricing_sensitivity_p1.pdf) — attaching the critical slides to the internal memo. If we proceed, Jordan should draft the memo for Marissa with the risk/benefit bullets.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_sensitivity_p1.pdf

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-06-10T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Executive approval request — Zenith Biomed pilot rate variance (ZEN-3492)

Marissa —

Short brief: Zenith Biomed (prospect moving to pilot) requests a one-time commercial exception: 45% off hosted rates for a 6-month pilot, waiver of onboarding surcharge, and 3 months monitoring credits. They estimate ~20M tokens/month.

Why we should consider:
- Strategic vertical (clinical device integrations) with high expansion motion to Dedicated; early access could lead to a multi-year Dedicated commit.
- Public reference potential and co-marketing with their clinical ops teams.

Proposed exception (recommended by pricing):
- Staged discount: 35% months 1–3, 25% months 4–6
- Prepayment: 2 months equivalent applied as credits on execution
- Hard cap: 30M tokens/month; overage at list -10%
- Monitoring credits: 90 days
- Credit applied back if they convert to Dedicated within 12 months (retro true-up).

Risk: Margin compression up front; potential higher support load during pilot. Mitigations: prepay, cap, and conversion true-up.

Attachments: exec_summary.docx (short memo + P&L bridge).

Asks:
1) Exec signoff to offer the above exception to Zenith.
2) If approved, authority level: VP/CFO signoff required for >30% average concession. This lands in that bucket (avg concession ~30–33%).

Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the numbers.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Director, Commercial Operations
jordan@redwood.com

Condition: Zenith must sign the PO for the 6-month pilot with the 2-month prepayment within 10 business days of the commercial terms being sent, and the contract must include the 30M token hard cap and conversion true-up language. Operational note: Please include a short MOP (monitoring ops playbook) and assign an SRE point-of-contact for the first 30 days post-go-live. Approving now to enable Sofia to move quickly on the prospect.
